OUR SERVICES

From moving out
to moving forward.

Cleaning and maintenance enquiries for rental properties in Sydney. Scope, pricing and timing are agreed separately for each job.

End-of-lease cleaning

Cleaning options for the end of a tenancy, with the scope agreed for each property.

  • Kitchen, oven and rangehood
  • Bathrooms, showers and toilets
  • Floors, skirting boards and cupboards
  • Internal window cleaning and accessible window tracks
  • Carpet cleaning and additional services by arrangement

Minor repairs and touch-ups

Minor repairs for everyday wear and tear during and between tenancies.

  • Wall patching and paint touch-ups
  • Doors, handles, hinges and locks
  • Cupboard fittings, blinds and flyscreens
  • Bathroom silicone and minor grout repairs
  • Garden tidying and outdoor upkeep

Specialist service coordination

Specialist services may be discussed separately, subject to assessment and availability.

  • Plumbing leaks and drainage issues
  • Electrical faults and lighting
  • Air conditioning and appliance servicing
  • Pest control and specialist cleaning

Specialist work is not included unless separately agreed. Any licensing requirements must be confirmed before work is arranged.
